steps.en: Install reviewed tooling and initialize a trusted repository
steps.zh: 安装审核过的工具并初始化可信仓库

steps.en: Adds a local gate remote and starts the daemon
steps.zh: 添加本地门禁远端并启动后台进程

component.zh: 裸仓库门禁与后台进程

steps.en: Push committed work to the gate instead of origin
steps.zh: 把已提交改动推到门禁而非原远端

steps.en: Reviews, tests and fixes in a separate worktree; parks unresolved findings
steps.zh: 在独立工作区评审测试修复，暂停待裁决问题

steps.en: Open the terminal UI and decide unresolved findings
steps.zh: 打开终端界面并裁决未解决问题

steps.en: Publishes the validated branch, opens the PR and monitors CI
steps.zh: 发布验证后的分支，创建 PR 并监控 CI

component.zh: 推送、PR 与 CI 步骤

value.en: One tracked run replaces manual repair, approval and PR handoffs; you still decide the merge
value.zh: 一次可追踪运行接管修复、审批和 PR 交接，合并仍由你决定
